-- True when the path, after resolving `.` and `..` segments, stays inside
-- its starting directory. Absolute paths and any path that climbs above
-- the root are not inside.
stays_inside(path: str) -> bool =
  ex stays_inside("a.txt") == True
  ex stays_inside("sub/../a.txt") == True
  ex stays_inside("..") == False
  ex stays_inside("/etc/passwd") == False
  ex stays_inside("sub/../../x") == False
  let parts = path.split("/")
  if parts.len() > 1 and parts[0] == ""
    return False
  var depth = 0
  for seg in parts
    if seg == "" or seg == "."
      continue
    if seg == ".."
      depth -= 1
      if depth < 0
        return False
    else
      depth += 1
  True

-- Text of the file at `path` inside the directory `notes`, or "" when the
-- path escapes `notes` or the file is missing or unreadable.
read_public(path: str) -> str uses fs =
  ex read_public("..") == ""
  ex read_public("/etc/passwd") == ""
  ex read_public("sub/../../x") == ""
  if not stays_inside(path)
    return ""
  var result = ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    result = fs.read(path) else ""
  result
